title: Weaver issues
description: Where the issues of this project are filed. Without this file, closing as `issue` with `weaver close` only records it.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, for the editor.

command.description: The command that files an issue for what the owner closes as `issue` with `weaver close`, as its words, with `{title}`, `{body}` and `{labels}` where they go.
